details: Binance, the world's largest cryptocurrency exchange, has suspended withdrawals following a suspected security breach that allegedly resulted in an estimated $6 billion in stolen assets. Analysts indicate this could be the largest crypto heist on record, with some attributing the attack to a North Korea-linked group. The incident has triggered a significant downturn in cryptocurrency prices, including Bitcoin, which fell to a six-week low. Binance has committed to covering all losses from its company funds and is actively collaborating with industry partners and law enforcement to trace and freeze affected assets.
title: Binance Suffers Record $6 Billion Security Breach, Crypto Markets Fall

details: On October 29, 2026, the European Central Bank's (ECB) Governing Council announced its decision to maintain the three key ECB interest rates at their current levels. This move comes as rising energy prices continue to present upside risks to inflation and downside risks to economic growth in the Euro area. The ECB affirmed its commitment to achieving its 2% inflation target in the medium term and stated that future monetary policy decisions would remain data-dependent.
title: ECB Holds Key Interest Rates Steady Amid Inflation and Growth Concerns
